title: Gumball Live Preview During Transform
description: The 3D gumball currently doesn't show a live preview while using the transform utility. Make it update during drag (e.g. puzzle 3d).
summary:
Fixed missing 3D gumball live preview during transform drags.

Root cause: World3dHost only dispatched translate/rotate/scale on gumball drag end, so the widget moved but scene instances stayed at committed poses until release.

Changes: World3dHost now brackets gumball drags with transformBegin/transformEnd, dispatches incremental transform deltas on every UnifiedGumball onDrag tick, and flushes any final micro-delta on drag end. Added exported gumballTransformDeltaBetweenPoses helper + unit tests. Lowpoly render overlays the in-progress transform scratch projection for scratch-commit preview.

Verified: framework-renderer-react gumballTransformDeltaBetweenPoses test passes.
